fixed.problem: L3-run-5: after Stop now during a call, the task read CHF 0.01 (Tasks row, drawer, cap fell) while the session, the session page, Costs > By task and Left this month read CHF 0.00. Root cause, confirmed at base 112227c: the abort branch in packages/runtime/src/agent/loop.ts added the cut-off call's message_start usage to the run's own total and rethrew. It skipped hooks.afterModelCall, the only writer of the ledger row and the session budget, and it skipped model_call_end, which the runner books task and session spend from. The runner then added the run's total to the task as its rest. The bench stand-in sent no usage on message_start, so only the real model showed it.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/loop.test.ts "a call the kill switch cuts off keeps the input tokens its message_start reported in the run's usage and cost" (extended: 1 ledger row with the run's ids, session budget 5000, one model_call_end, run total still 5000) and "l3-money-engine, run L3: a cut-off call is booked once (L3-run-5) > a call the run's timeout cuts off is booked on the ledger and the session's budget too"; apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts "l3-money-engine, run L3 > L3-run-5: a call Stop now cuts off is booked once: the task, the session, Costs and the month say one figure, also after a restart" (at base: ledger 0 against run cost 62070)
fixed.how: The abort branch now books the cut-off call like any other call. It calls afterModelCall(ctx, usage, cost, { afterStop: true }), because Stop has already revoked the token; a failed booking is logged and never hides the stop. It then emits model_call_end with stopReason "error", and only when the call reported usage. The runner's end-of-run rest is then 0, so nothing is counted twice. Siblings: intake, chat and critic all run through LoopAgentDriver, so they are covered by the same branch. The SDK path already books late usage (R-lateusage), so it needed no change. testenv/src/bench/role-player.ts now sends the input side on message_start, as the Messages API does, so the bench and the stand-in suites walk this path. Docs updated: adding-a-provider.md, runtime.md (kill mid-run) and testing.md (bench stand-in).

Critic: planEstimateOf counts each task once, at its first item's figure. When a stored row repeats a task (rows written before the fix), it recomputes from the first item per task. The duplicate finding skips a repeat that is marked again, whose task was sent back, or that already ran in the session. An overrun finding now names a second try (new attemptsAgainOf). new_problems: On a routed provider (intake, chat, critic), a call cut off by Stop or a timeout is booked on the run's current billing source: the run's default, or the last routed call's source. The routed provider's error event carries only a sourceId, not the source's billing kind, so if the router had moved the cut-off call to another source, the ledger row names the earlier one. Minor. Evidence: provider/routed.ts yields { ...failed, sourceId } on error, and message_end alone carries billing.

notes_for_other_areas: loop.ts abort branch (C3 d1109-chat-depth, D3-12): when a cut-off call reported usage, the branch now does three things before rethrowing controller.signal.reason. It runs `await hooks.afterModelCall(ctx, response.usage, callCost, { afterStop: true })` in a try/catch that only logs. It adds the call to the run's usage and cost as before. It emits `model_call_end { turn, usage, costUsdMicro: callCost, ttftMs, stopReason: "error" }`. A call with no usage books nothing and emits no end, as before. So an aborted chat turn through LoopAgentDriver now has a ledger row equal to its cost: D3-12's 'call's cost equals the ledger's rows for the turn' holds through this branch.

critic/src/session-review.ts (C6 d1109-selftasks-chat, SC-13):
- SessionPlanItemLike gains `again?: boolean`, and planItemsOf reads it.
- planEstimateOf(plan, items) counts each taskId once, at its first non-again item. It recomputes from items whenever they repeat a task or carry again; otherwise it returns the stored total as before.
- New export attemptsAgainOf(items) counts repeats plus again items; the overrun finding uses it to append ', with one task tried twice' or ', with N more attempts of tasks tried again'.
- In sessionChecks, two sets are built before the plan-items loop: sentBackHere (handoff.sent_back) and ranHereBefore (non-critic runs of the session). The 'Plan lists the same task twice' check skips a repeat when item.again or either set has the task.
- SC-13's split/dropped counting at the duplicate check should keep these exemptions.

runner.ts (C2 to C6 rebasing on the replan):
- PlanItem gains `again?: boolean`.
- replan() maps cut.items to `{ ...i, again: true }` when current.items already has that taskId, and adds only the non-again items' estimates to plan.estimateUsdMicro. The setPlan reason, the session.replanned event (whose estimateUsdMicro is still cut.estimateUsdMicro) and the returned queue items (cut.items, unmarked) are unchanged.
- takeHeld() marks the larger task again when it is already in items, and then adds no room to the plan's figure; plan.oversized.roomUsdMicro is still overwritten as before.

runner.ts reviewTask (TR/critic areas): critic.review_started is no longer emitted before critic.reviewTask. TaskReviewRequest (loop/ports.ts) gains `onStarted?: () => void`. loop/critic.ts passes `onEvent` to CriticService.review's context and calls onStarted on the first `model_call_start`. The runner emits the start line then, or just before the verdict when no model call ran, and never on a refusal or wait. A CriticPort test double that never calls onStarted still gets the line, right before its verdict.

critic.session_review payload gains an optional `waitsFor: "answers" | "decision"`, set by the runner from needsYouNow (paused cards excluded) plus failedNow, all holding open cards. views.ts renders 'Session review: the work waits for your answers|decision (grade N, M findings).' A later area that rewords this line should update apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts, event-lines.test.ts and session-keeps-going.test.ts ('l3-money-engine, run L3').

testenv/src/bench/role-player.ts: every reply's message_start now carries `usage` (input, cache read and cache write tokens, output 0). A stand-in call cut off by Stop now or a timeout now costs its input on the ledger, the session and the task. Tests that stop a stand-in mid-call and expect CHF 0.00 would see a few hundred micro-USD; none in the suite did.
